I can’t keep watching the vendor portal or message you later unless you enable an automation I can actually run — I can’t do background monitoring from here. I won’t say “on it” unless a real watcher is created.

Options I can do right now so you can shut your laptop:

- Set up an automated watcher/alert (requires you to grant access or connect the portal or email account). If you want this, tell me which access you can provide (portal credentials, API, or permission to create an email rule) and I’ll give exact next steps.
- Draft a short message you can send to the vendor asking them to notify you when the SOC 2 report is posted — I can draft it now.
- Give step-by-step instructions to enable the vendor-portal notification or create a browser/email rule on your device so you get an immediate alert.
- Create calendar reminders for you to manually check at times you pick.

Which would you like? If you want the draft message now, here’s a quick template you can send immediately:
"Hi [Vendor name], please notify me as soon as the SOC 2 report is published to the portal. Thanks, [Your name]"

Tell me which option and any needed details (vendor name, email, or what access you can provide).
